Staff App — Quick Start

Everything you need to run the booking calendar day to day at The Vintage Loft.

You can’t break anything by exploring — changes save as you go, and nothing sends to a client unless you choose to send it.
1

Sign in

Open the Staff App and enter the staff password. You’ll stay signed in on that device for about a month. Tap Show password if you want to check what you typed.
2

Your schedule

The calendar is your home base. Circled days have a booking or hold; empty days are wide open. Tap any day to see who’s in.
3

See a day — Timeline view

Tapping a day opens the Timeline: each studio in its own column (North Wing, Grand, Dream, Gatsby, Carnegie, Marilyn), with every session placed by time. Studios with nothing booked that day are hidden — scroll sideways to see more. Tap any block to jump to its full details.
4

…or the List view

Prefer the detail? Tap List for the full cards grouped by studio, each tagged Booking or Hold, with all the action buttons — payments, notes, cancel, edit. Tap the date again to fold the day away.
5

A booking’s details & payment

Open a booking to Call / Message / Email the client, add notes, Mark as paid (choose how they paid and the date), or send the confirmation email. You can also cancel (with or without credit), edit, or quietly delete one the client was never told about.
A paid booking sends a receipt; an unpaid one sends a “reserved” email with a payment link — the Send confirmation email button handles both.
6

Add a booking or a hold

Use Add to the calendar to slot something in yourself: pick the studio, date and time, choose Booking or Hold, add the client’s info and a note, and (optionally) email them the confirmation with a payment link.
7

All your upcoming holds

Holding reservations lists every future hold in one place — review these weekly. Tap one to jump to its day, then turn it into a booking or let it go.
8

Make your own discount code

Running a sale? Create a code yourself in Discount codes — percent or dollar off, studio‑only or everything, with an optional usage limit and expiry. It works the moment you save it, and you can turn it off anytime.
9

Gift cards

Gift cards shows every card sold or issued, with its live balance and status. You can void a card, or issue one by hand (a prize or make‑good) with no payment.
